description: Elections Commission - B. A. L. Vijith of the Kotapola Pradeshiya Sabha has vacated his member of the Sri Lanka Podujana Peramuna - P. G. S. reasoning: This gazette contains multiple notices under Section 10 A(1)(a) of the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance, specifically declaring that members of the Pradeshiya Sabha have vacated their offices due to ceasing to be members of their political party. This content directly relates to electoral processes and the status of elected officials in local government bodies, making it clearly fall under the Elections category (Type 7).
